caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object with a lattice-like structure, resembling an elongated teardrop or leaf shape. The object is shown in three views on a beige background: top view, side view, and an isometric perspective. The top view outlines the symmetrical, geometric framework consisting of several intersecting straight bars that form quadrilaterals and triangles within the main outer shape. The object has a circular hole near the wider end, possibly for mounting or handling. The side view shows that the structure is flat with short vertical supports underneath. The isometric view at the bottom of the drawing reflects the object's three-dimensional form and depth, emphasizing its hollow framework and construction. The color scheme predominantly features shades of gray and black for the object, with the background remaining a uniform, aged beige. A small linear scale is included in the middle section for reference, and there is a handwritten name at the bottom right corner of the page.
title: Flat Iron Holder
